items: Peaceful, luxurious setting a short drive from Seaside, Watercolor etc. We are a 7-10 min walk or a 2 min golf cart ride to a great beach access. Blue Mountain Creamery, a favorite for kids of all ages, is a short walk from our home. Hwy 30-A is a 17 mile county Hwy, that runs along the coast- w/ bike path the entire length. We have 3 king beds, 1 queen, a bunk w/full on bottom, twin on top, two folding cots + fold out twin bed ottoman. You can comfortable accommodate your family and friends. Huge wrap around porch w/ part of it screened; Swing, outdoor round table plus outdoor sofa & chairs makes this a perfect hang out spot after a day of playing in the gulf. 6 flat screen TV's (one in each bedroom/bunk area/screened porch and of course the living room) WiFi streaming service/UtubeTV. Our home sits on a half acre lot making it almost completely private...you can listen to the birds in the morning, and many times you can hear the waves. At night, you'll hear crickets, frogs & owls. Once you visit our little piece of paradise, you'll want to come back. Golf Cart, Chairs, umbrellas, a paddle board, some life vests, and corn hole set provided. You'll also enjoy a commercial ice machine that makes all the ice you'll need. We provide great vendors for renting additional Yolo boards, kayaks, bikes etc that will be delivered and picked up when you're finished.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
